name: energyshield-ai-workspace
description: EnergyShield AI - Supply Chain Resilience (Root workspace to run frontend and backend together)

scripts.dev: concurrently --shell "C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe" -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "yellow.bold,cyan.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently --shell "C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe" -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "yellow.bold,cyan.bold" "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
